distribution.title: Exponential distribution
distribution.intro: The exponential distribution models a nonnegative waiting time with constant rate \(\lambda>0\).
distribution.formula: For \(x\ge0\), its density is \(f(x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}\) and its CDF is \(F(x)=1-e^{-\lambda x}\).
distribution.properties: Its mean is \(1/\lambda\), its variance is \(1/\lambda^2\), and it has the memoryless property: \(P(X>s+t\mid X>s)=P(X>t)\) for nonnegative \(s,t\).
distribution.course: The course derives an exponential sample using the inversion method and uses the distribution in an estimating-function example.
distribution.r_intro: These examples use functions from R’s stats package. For functions with d, p, q, and r prefixes, they compute a density or mass, cumulative probability, quantile, and random samples, respectively.
